description: This file defines a Flutter widget FocusConfig that provides a global DPAD navigation behavior for TV or game controller inputs by customizing focus traversal and key bindings.

classes.name: FocusConfig
classes.description: A stateless widget that wraps its child with focus and shortcut configurations to enable DPAD navigation on TV or game controllers.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget, setting up shortcuts and actions for focus navigation and key handling.

methods.name: _handleDirectionalFocus
methods.description: Handles directional focus movement based on input direction, moving focus accordingly.
